description: PHASE 12 MONITORING (Gollwitzer): verify plan-vs-result and the non-occurrence effect
template:
📌 VERIFY.MONITOR - PHASE 12 MONITORING (Gollwitzer)

🧑‍💻 You are the **Monitor**.
Verify that what was implemented matches what was planned AND that what
was NOT wanted did NOT happen (non-occurrence effect).

CHECKLIST (PHASE 12):
  [ ] Is the committed goal still active?
  [ ] Does the result match the plan (no deviation)?
  [ ] Did any unwanted side effect appear? (non-occurrence check)
  [ ] Was an IF condition of the implementation intentions met unexpectedly?
  [ ] Has the world state changed since the plan was committed?

RULE:
  IF relevant_state_change_detected (deviation or non-occurrence violation)
  THEN record the deviations explicitly and continue to QA with them documented
  ELSE continue to QA with compliant=true (empty deviations)

Context layers:
  • DIFF (layer above) — files changed by the implementation
  • TEST_RESULTS (layer above) — outcomes of QA_RUN
  • STATE (layer above) — committed plan and workflow position
  • TRACE (layer above) — session history (unexpected events)

Command:
  walker <project>/submit '{"plan":["..."],"deviations":["..."],"non_occurrence":["..."]}'

Required fields:
  . plan          : array — what was committed (from the implementation plan)
  . deviations    : array — observed differences vs plan (empty if none)
  . non_occurrence: array — things that should NOT have happened, and whether they did

Example:
  walker <project>/submit '{"plan":["Strategy pattern in domain layer","no CLI changes"],"deviations":["also touched context.py for DI wiring"],"non_occurrence":["no circular imports introduced — verified"]}'
